principles: Freshness is evaluated per source and per fact domain; a recent analytics article cannot refresh rules data.
Current official source claims must be rechecked after a known publication/update event.
Git-backed structured sources are tracked by commit SHA, not by a vague checked date alone.
Runtime projections are checked against their upstream structured source when a discrepancy appears.
